# PoseTrackPlayer

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/humanbot.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/humanbot.h) · Scene / prefab name: `PoseTrackPlayer` · Described in `data/agents_humanbot.json`

Kinematic playback of a baked pose track on the walker's bodies.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `track` | `std::string` | Track file under resources/ (.track.json, with its .track.bin), required. |
| `loop` | `bool` | Wrap to frame 0 at the end (teleporting), else hold the last frame. |
| `teleport` | `bool` | SetPositionAndRotation every frame instead of MoveKinematic. |
| `playing` | `bool` | Not in JSON; true. |
| `frame` | `int` | Current frame. |
| `data` | `std::shared_ptr<const PoseTrack>` | The loaded track (TrackActions init). |

## Notes

On the HumanBotSpawn entity of rig_world (kinematic, recording). TrackActions checks the track's body and dt.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: TrackActions. Created by: —. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [TrackActions](../systems/TrackActions.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | init (data), tick (frame) | Loads the track, advances the frame. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[TrackActions](../systems/TrackActions.md)**
  - Reads resources/<track>.track.json and its .track.bin; throws AssetError for another body or another dt.
  - Moves the kinematic Jolt bodies of the walker.
